In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

hADM is an appropriate adjunct for the wound healing process in a patient with chronic open wounds, which fail to heal after multiple treatment failures with Negative Pressure Wound Treatment, porcine Acellular Dermis, split thickness skin grafts and local wound care.
hADM is a good alternative to autologous skin grafts, especially in cases of large wounds, with the advantage of being a single procedure.
hADMs are a valid alternative to autologous dermo-epidermal grafts, in the treatment of chronic wounds.

human acellular dermat matrix can be an adjunct for wound healing in chronic open wounds after multiple treatments failure.

hADM can be used in patients requiring treatment for chronic open wounds after multiple unsuccessful treatments with other types of dermal substitutes, such as porcine acelullar dermal matrix.
